channel.title: AzRoleWatcher
channel.description: Continuously monitor roles and permissions in Microsoft Entra ID and Azure.

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 08debc4b-0ada-478e-b198-db165d97e7de
Display name: Chaos Scenario Operator
Description: Can validate configurations and execute, cancel, and monitor Chaos Studio scenario runs. Cannot author or delete workspace resources, trigger discovery or evaluation, or fix resource permissions. Intended for SREs and on-call engineers.
Link: https://management.azure.com/08debc4b-0ada-478e-b198-db165d97e7de?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 1091dee8-a09b-4205-95fa-b0100e8f006d
Display name: Chaos Permissions Admin
Description: Can review and fix resource permissions for Chaos Studio scenario configurations, with read-only access to other workspace resources and results. Cannot author resources, trigger discovery or evaluation, validate configurations, or execute or cancel runs. Intended for security and IAM administrators.
Link: https://management.azure.com/1091dee8-a09b-4205-95fa-b0100e8f006d?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 2b7c9e07-f345-488e-ac2f-78e83b45fda4
Display name: Container Registry Connected Registry Sync Reader
Description: Grants the data-plane permissions required to list repositories, read repository content and metadata, and communicate with the ACR gateway for ReadOnly Connected Registry synchronization.
Link: https://management.azure.com/2b7c9e07-f345-488e-ac2f-78e83b45fda4?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 9a6bb34c-81a2-4692-b7e4-d892eb1f56b5
Display name: Chaos Workspace Contributor
Description: Can manage Chaos Studio workspaces and connections, discover resources, evaluate recommendations, author and validate scenarios and configurations, and execute and cancel runs. Cannot fix resource permissions. Intended for workspace owners.
Link: https://management.azure.com/9a6bb34c-81a2-4692-b7e4-d892eb1f56b5?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: e85263c4-8ef3-4ab1-82a4-f6d18e75d328
Display name: Container Registry Connected Registry Sync Contributor
Description: Grants the data-plane permissions required to list repositories; read, write, and delete repository content and metadata; and communicate with the ACR gateway for ReadWrite Connected Registry synchronization.
Link: https://management.azure.com/e85263c4-8ef3-4ab1-82a4-f6d18e75d328?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: ❌ REMOVED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 3f6d1a95-b7c8-4e2b-8f04-d91a6ce7235e
Display name: Red Team Administrator
Description: Read approved Azure reconnaissance, security posture, Key Vault metadata, and Log Analytics information, and create or delete Azure role assignments within approved scopes.
Link: https://management.azure.com/3f6d1a95-b7c8-4e2b-8f04-d91a6ce7235e?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: ❌ REMOVED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 7e2a3b84-6f91-4c5d-b8a2-1f37e9d4ac60
Display name: Red Team Recon Agent - Azure
Description: Read approved Azure resources and security metadata.
Link: https://management.azure.com/7e2a3b84-6f91-4c5d-b8a2-1f37e9d4ac60?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: ❌ REMOVED Azure role
item.description:
Id: c1d8f2a9-45be-4f73-9a16-8b02d5e7f4c1
Display name: Red Team Web App Agent
Description: Read approved Azure web application, configuration, network exposure, storage account, registry, and managed identity information for web application penetration testing.
Link: https://management.azure.com/c1d8f2a9-45be-4f73-9a16-8b02d5e7f4c1?api-version=2022-04-01
